scope: Real native Skia Canvas rasterization + Cocos lifecycle/GPU doubles. NOT Creator engine, Mac, WeChat or phone acceptance. This suite explicitly selects the retained original painted-2d comparison backend. Shipping default is tested separately by test_result_chest_3d.cjs.
checks: Real Skia 256px art: five lid states, gradients/grain, visible cavity, distinct closed/open pixels; alpha bounds fill >97% of height
100 alternating closed/open page entries leave zero ImageAsset, Texture2D and SpriteFrame allocations
Identical state reuses resources; changed state releases old assets; invalid open clamps closed; disposal is idempotent and blocks late updates
GPU upload failure destroys all candidate objects, preserves old frame, permits retry, and releases on dispose
Missing Canvas renders a bounded error label, leaves page controls available, retries cleanly without stale label
WeChat offscreen factory is preferred; createCanvas fallback checked with doubles (not device verified)
Resource substitution/lifecycle contract tested with a lease double; real 3D implementation is tested separately
